reviews.name: Jen Rush
reviews.text: Oscar and the team did a fantastic job replacing all of our gutters and fascia. On time, cleaned up everything and great pricing. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Marcel vK
reviews.text: The guys from Arizona Roofing did a great job at my parents house. Professional, on time, well priced and good communication. Highly recommend these guys!!

reviews.name: Peter Arvanitis
reviews.text: This is the second job Oscar has done for me and for good reason. Major roof repairs were needed for my 3 bedroom house. Great work, customer experience and satisfaction awsome. His quote was very competitive. Keep up the great work Oscar.

reviews.name: Louie Lavender
reviews.text: Asghar (Oscar) was amazing, from start to finish he was kind, genuine and helpful. Whole roof repointing, collars, dektites, and clips in the valley. All installed to a high standard and at a very reasonable price.

reviews.name: Yujuan Liu
reviews.text: Oscar was very kind and helpful. He did an excellent job ridgeds the entire roof and re-taping the valley collar. It was done on time, cleanly, and professionally every step of the way.

reviews.name: 刘康
reviews.text: I highly recommend Oscar to anyone who need their roof fixed. Oscar explained what he planned to do in details, patiently discussing the date to accommodate both sides’ need and did an excellent job!

_source.aboutText:
At Arizona Roofing, we are dedicated to providing top-notch roofing solutions for both residential and commercial properties in Canberra. With years of industry experience, our team of expert roofing professionals is committed to delivering exceptional services that meet our clients’ needs and exceed their expectations.

Our comprehensive range of roofing services includes roof restoration, roof repairs, gutter replacement, gutter guards, roof painting, and metal roofing repairs. Whether your roof needs a complete makeover, repairs to address leaks and damages, or the installation of new gutters and guards, we have the expertise to handle it all. We pride ourselves on delivering fast and efficient repairs, ensuring that your roof is restored to its optimal condition in no time.

At Arizona Roofing, we understand the importance of a sturdy and reliable roof for the protection of your property. That’s why we prioritize quality workmanship and utilize the latest industry techniques and materials to ensure the longevity and durability of our roofing solutions. We are a registered business with a team of experienced and professional roofing experts who are passionate about delivering exceptional results. Our commitment to customer satisfaction, affordable pricing, and reliable service has made us the go-to choice for roofing solutions in Canberra.
